experiments/docs/render.tsx

JSX template for <view-docs> — extracted from Docs.tsx.
Sourcesrc/experiments/docs/render.tsx
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

docsHref

Absolute /docs route for a manifest-relative path — the canonical URL every navigation surface (tree rows, grid cards, crumbs) carries as a real href so crawlers, reader mode, and new-tab gestures all resolve.

  • @param subPath Manifest-relative path ('' → portal root).
  • @returns The portal-relative URL.

treeHref

The URL a tree-row click actually lands on: an expanded dir the viewer sits inside collapses UP one level, so its href mirrors the parent — every other row maps to its own canonical /docs/.

  • @param view The host docs view (reads docsPath for the inside check).
  • @param node The manifest node the row renders.
  • @param open Whether the dir row is currently expanded.
  • @returns The destination URL for the row's href.

treeNodes

Recursive tree rows — each node renders a

  • with an anchor (dirs toggle open AND navigate; files navigate). Real hrefs keep the tree crawlable and give right-click/new-tab native semantics; plain clicks stay on the SPA router. Children render inside a nested
      only while the dir is in the host's open-set — per the self-similar recursion rule the tree walks itself.

      gridCards

      Grid cards — dirs and files get the generated folder SVG and navigate into/open the node on click. Rendered as real anchors so the folder grid is crawlable and new-tab gestures work natively.

      crumbBar

      Editable breadcrumb strip — each crumb is a jump-to link; the trailing input carries the full relative path and commits on Enter (Escape restores the current path).

      renderDocs

      The docs template — assembled for ViewDocs.render().
